business_overview.one_sentence: The group mainly provides higher education in media and arts, vocational education and international education in Mainland China, with a smaller entertainment and livestreaming e-commerce business.

segments.name: Higher education, vocational education and international education
segments.source: 2025 Annual Report Note 5, segment revenue and results, p.92

segments.name: Entertainment and livestreaming e-commerce
segments.source: 2025 Annual Report Note 5, segment revenue and results, p.92

business_overview.revenue_model: Education revenue is mainly tuition and boarding fees, generally received in advance before the school year and then recognized over the service period; livestreaming e-commerce revenue is commission and promotion fees.
business_notes: At 31 December 2025 the group had about 30,785 students.
The Olympic College acquisition remained incomplete; RMB420 million bridging loans were included in other receivables with accumulated impairment of RMB240.7 million.
The group stated it had no plan to invest in new TV or film projects in the future.

profit_cash_conversion.assessment: Operating cash flow exceeded parent net profit in 2024 and 2025 and stayed positive in 2023, but 2023-2024 profit was distorted by large impairments and 2025 is only one strong post-impairment year. Education prepayments make operating cash flow look strong, so distribution capacity still needs a haircut.

Used only for 2023 profit and cash-flow comparison.

gaps: Annual report did not disclose cash, time deposits and structured deposits by offshore parent, PRC subsidiaries, schools and VIE/contractual arrangement entities.
Annual report did not disclose restricted or otherwise earmarked cash beyond RMB0.411 million court-frozen bank deposit.
Annual report did not disclose a precise maintenance-capex split; owner-earnback analysis estimates maintenance capex from recent purchase of property and equipment and depreciation/amortisation.
Annual report did not provide a direct legal schedule showing which cash balances can be distributed to the listed offshore parent.
